# Architecture Review (Enterprise Review)

This review records issues identified in the source material (`ROADMAP.md`) during the consolidation into this repository. Per the review mandate, issues are **documented, not silently fixed**; each is tracked to a resolution (new RFC, normalization, or backlog item).

## 1. Summary

The source contained five well-developed RFCs (RFC-0001..0005) plus numerous forward references to RFCs that were never written. The material was internally strong but suffered from inconsistent RFC numbering, an under-developed authentication RFC, and missing specifications for whole subsystems.

## 2. Inconsistencies

| ID | Issue | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| RV-01 | Forward references reuse the same RFC number for different subsystems (e.g. RFC-0006 appears as "Secure Enclave", "Storage Engine", "Key Management", "Runtime", "Database"). | Canonical numbering fixed in `rfc_registry.py`; see [RFC Index](../rfcs/README.md). |
| RV-02 | Inconsistent frontmatter keys/casing (`rfc:` vs `RFC:`, `title:` vs `Title:`). | Normalized during migration. |
| RV-03 | Per-part section numbering restarts arbitrarily. | Preserved verbatim in migrated parts; new RFCs use consistent numbering. |
| RV-04 | Mixed heading levels for RFC/Part titles. | Standardized nav headers added. |

## 3. Duplicated Concepts

| ID | Duplication | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| RV-05 | Secure Enclave specified in RFC-0003 Part 8 and referenced as a separate RFC. | Promoted to [RFC-0006](../rfcs/RFC-0006/README.md). |
| RV-06 | Key management in RFC-0003 Part 2 and referenced as RFC-0007/0008. | Consolidated in [RFC-0007](../rfcs/RFC-0007/README.md). |
| RV-07 | Secure memory in RFC-0003 Part 7 and referenced separately. | Promoted to [RFC-0009](../rfcs/RFC-0009/README.md). |
| RV-08 | Migration in RFC-0003 Part 10 and RFC-0005. | Consolidated in [RFC-0013](../rfcs/RFC-0013/README.md). |

## 4. Under-Developed RFCs

| ID | Issue | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| RV-09 | RFC-0004 Authentication has only Part 1 (philosophy). Missing: passkey ceremony, recovery flow, session bootstrap, enterprise SSO, state-machine detail. | Backlog: expand RFC-0004 Parts 2–5; dependencies now formalized via RFC-0006/0008/0011/0018. |

## 7. Residual Risks / Open Items

- Post-quantum migration path is reserved but not committed (RFC-0003 Part 10 / RFC-0013).
- Malware-while-unlocked remains an accepted residual risk (RFC-0002 Part 7).
- Multi-device sync (RFC-0017) and enterprise (RFC-0018) are v2/v3 scope.
